page_title: LIV 1-0 ARS | Liverpool v Arsenal 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Wataru Endo (Liverpool) for a tough tackle.
90+8' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner with a short pass.

90+8' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
90+5' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
90+2' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Alisson leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
89' That's the end of the game for Noni Madueke, who is replaced by Max Dowman (Arsenal).
89' Arne Slot is forced to make a change. Florian Wirtz is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
88' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
88' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
86' Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

83' 1 - 0 Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) proved his free kick skills, especially from this distance. He hits the ball perfectly, putting it in off the left post and leaving the goalkeeper no chance at all.
82' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will take the free kick.
81' Chris Kavanagh shows the yellow card to Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) for a heavy challenge.
80' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
79' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ibrahima Konate limps off the pitch to be replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Ekitike departs the field of play to be replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
77' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) picks up an injury.
76' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
74' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
74' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
73' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
73' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
72' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
72' A pass into the penalty area from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
72' A clumsy foul by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle.
70' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli is replaced by Eberechi Eze (Arsenal).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Mikel Merino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a chip pass into the box, but David Raya is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) sees a yellow card from Chris Kavanagh after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
66' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but David Raya makes a save.
65' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Noni Madueke (Arsenal) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
64' Declan Rice (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

63' Gabriel (Arsenal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
61' Liverpool have a goal ruled out for offside!
61' A fine pass finds Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the David Raya reacts superbly to deny him.
59' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
58' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
55' The corner kick from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
55' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
52' Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
50' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Declan Rice (Arsenal) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
47' A crossfield pass from Gabriel (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates.
46' Referee Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
43' Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Gabriel (Arsenal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

40' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
40' Declan Rice (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

40' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Arsenal earn a corner.
39' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
37' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

36' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Noni Madueke (Arsenal) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Chris Kavanagh blows the whistle, Martin Zubimendi (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul.
34' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
34' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
33' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
30' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
29' The foul by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.
27' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
27' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Arsenal get a corner.
25' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
25' Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal). Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
23' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Alisson makes a simple save.
22' Declan Rice (Arsenal) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
22' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
20' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Chris Kavanagh who sees an offensive foul.
18' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
18' Noni Madueke (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Arsenal have a corner.
16' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
15' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
13' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
12' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
10' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
10' A cross from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
10' Mikel Merino (Arsenal) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
9' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
5' Mikel Arteta is forced to make an unplanned substitution as William Saliba (Arsenal) suffers an injury and Cristhian Mosquera comes on.
5' Looks like William Saliba (Arsenal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) tries to find Viktor Gyökeres, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Arsenal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
